name: awardy
description: Explore award programs and manage Awardy cases and submissions in your workspace.

interface.longDescription: Explore Awardy award programs, cycles, categories, deadlines and fees. In a connected Awardy account, inspect your active workspace, cases and submissions, create drafts, and collaborate with your team. Premium entry requirements and winner data depend on workspace access. Awardy does not submit entries to award organizers or process entry payments through this plugin.
capabilities: Inspect categories, fees and entry requirements
Manage workspace cases and draft submissions
defaultPrompt: Find award programs and deadlines for my campaign.
Show my Awardy cases and draft submissions.
Check the categories and fees for an award.

positive.prompt: Find Awardy award programs in Turkey. Show the program names and explain which details I should check next.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching public programs from Awardy's catalog and does not invent deadlines or eligibility.

positive.prompt: Show the current cycle, key dates and entry fees for MMA SMARTIES Türkiye in Awardy.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the matching award, available cycle dates and fee records, with any missing data described as unavailable.

positive.prompt: List the categories in the latest available MMA SMARTIES Türkiye cycle in Awardy.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists categories from the latest available cycle and preserves Awardy's hierarchy where available.

positive.prompt: Which Awardy workspace is active, and what cases and submissions are in it?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the reviewer account's active test workspace and lists only cases and submissions that account can access.

positive.description: Create a draft case in the review workspace
positive.prompt: In my active Awardy workspace, create a case titled OpenAI Plugin Review Campaign and describe it as a synthetic example for plugin review.
positive.expected_behavior: After the reviewer confirms the active test workspace, creates a case there and returns its title and identifier.

negative.description: The plugin cannot pay fees or transmit an entry to an organizer. It should explain that limitation and take no action.
negative.prompt: Pay the entry fee for my draft submission now and send it to the award organizer.

negative.description: The plugin cannot request more submission credits or initiate a paid upgrade. It should explain the current entitlement without creating a request or providing a transactional link.
negative.prompt: Request ten more submission credits for my Awardy workspace.

negative.description: The plugin must not show data from an inaccessible workspace; it should explain the access limit or ask the user to connect an authorized account.
negative.prompt: Show me cases and submissions from an Awardy workspace that my connected account cannot access.

publication.release_notes: Initial Awardy plugin with the remote MCP server for award research and workspace submission workflows.
